hypotheses.name: Coexpression-aware support-concordance interaction v2
hypotheses.method: Across immune/lung/external_lung with seeds 42/43/44, source/target-disjoint splits, and layers {7,11}, retained H70 triangle-defect scoring and tested high-vs-low support interaction using strata geodesic x degree x coexpression-proxy x ontology-overlap with support-shuffle, matched-random-support, and label-shuffle controls.
hypotheses.result_value: mean interaction=+0.00041; mean delta_AUROC(triangle-baseline)=+0.02323; interaction>0 rows 18/36; rows with null_gap_q95(interaction)>0: 11/36; null-surviving interaction mean domain-splits: 1/6; immune/source mean delta_AUROC=-0.00460
hypotheses.next_action: Do not scale this recipe; only rescue with a materially stronger biological anchor that directly improves immune/source and requires >=3/6 null-surviving domain-splits.

hypotheses.name: Cross-model relational rank agreement endpoint
hypotheses.method: Seed42 held-out-domain pilot on immune/lung/external_lung with source/target-disjoint splits and layers {7,11}; mapped Geneformer spectral signatures to scGPT via source-domain orthogonal alignment and evaluated non-edge relational agreement (delta Spearman and top-k overlap) against symbol-permutation, random-basis, and signature-destroy controls.
hypotheses.result_value: mean delta_spearman=+5.65e-06; mean delta_topk_overlap=+3.56e-05; mean null_gap_q95=-0.01897; delta_spearman>0 rows 5/12; rows with null_gap_q95>0: 0/12
hypotheses.next_action: Retire this cross-model mapping form; if revisited, switch to biology-stratified or motif-level invariants rather than global relational transfer.
hypotheses.retirement_reason: Major endpoint change still produced near-zero effect and uniformly negative null-gap support.

hypotheses.name: Geodesic detour-elasticity neighborhood-scale screen
hypotheses.method: Seed42 screen across immune/lung/external_lung and source/target-disjoint splits using layers {0,3,7,11}; computed detour-elasticity features from kNN geodesics at k={8,12,16} and tested incremental lift over geodesic/support baseline with endpoint-swap, feature-shuffle-within-bins, and label-shuffle controls.
hypotheses.result_value: mean delta_AUROC=+0.00193; positive rows 14/24; positive mean domain-splits 4/6; rows with p_best<0.05: 11/24; mean null_gap_q95 negative in all domain-splits (0/6 positive)
hypotheses.next_action: Keep only as a cheap probe with a materially changed perturbation mechanism (explicit neighbor dropout) and require positive null-gap in at least one domain-split before promotion.
